title: Level-metadata additions to Content Pack Format v1 (LL-09c)
description: These properties are merged onto pack-manifest-v0.schema.json at validator load time (see packages/packager/manifest.py::_compose_v1_schema) so the v0 core never drifts. All additions are OPTIONAL: a manifest without level fields is a valid v1 document interpreted as level_target=[micro, certificate] (back-compat rule).

level_target.description: Canonical pathway levels (LL-09a) this pack serves. A pack can serve multiple.

prerequisites.description: Edges of a DIRECTED ACYCLIC graph; the packager rejects cycles (packages/packager/manifest.py).

credit_value.description: Credit hours contributed on degree pathways.

rubric_ref.description: OPAQUE reference to the LL-05 verification engine's rubric (rubric_id@version). Shape validated here only; the verification engine owns rubric semantics.
